notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
A patch has been released for Whirlwind Magician. Here are the changes:
[list]
[*]Made one of the strength fruits easier to obtain. (Hover over spoilers for details - these spoil how to get it as well as info about a [i]different[/i] secret item)
[spoiler]The strength fruit that requires using the Slingshot Jump ability to cross a large pit between Treetops East and Treetops West now only requires a single Slingshot Jump in order to reach.
[u]Developer Commentary[/u]: Previously this large pit could not be crossed with only a single Slingshot Jump - it required some additional movement to cross the full distance. I've noticed that members of the community believe it requires performing two Slingshot Jumps in a row in order to cross it, which is quite difficult to perform. However, this was not actually the intended method to cross the pit. The intended method was to perform a Slingshot Jump and then throw Gibson downwards multiple times in the air to stall your fall, since throwing Gibson downwards boosts yourself up slightly.
I have decided that this was too cryptic since the downward throw boost is never explicitly stated in-game and acquiring the Slingshot Jump powerup in the first place already requires some clever thinking. So now crossing the pit only requires a single Slingshot Jump. I believe this will result in a better experience because when players finally have that "a ha!" moment in figuring out how to get the Slingshot Jump powerup, they will then be able to use it to cross the pit and feel smart in finding the Slingshot Jump's application, rather than being immediately hit with another cryptic puzzle.[/spoiler]
[*]Added another playtester to the ending credits
[*]Removed an unnecessary [spoiler]Command Magic powerup[/spoiler] in Treetops East due to it misleading some players into thinking there might be a secret in that room (the room right after you get the ability to [spoiler]control Gibson[/spoiler]).
[*]Fixed the blurry rotated arrow sprite towards the end of the ruins.
[/list]

If you encounter any issues playing the game after downloading this update, please let me know in the discussion section below or email me at samuraimantis.help@gmail.com.

notes.title: Community Spotlight #1: Speedrun by Sekeri_rat!
notes.content:
Welcome to the first Whirlwind Magician Community Spotlight, where I highlight one or more things from Whirlwind Magician players and fans that I think are cool! (These posts will not be scheduled)

Today I'd like to spotlight Whirlwind Magician's first recorded speedrun, completed by French Twitch streamer Sekeri_rat!

He first started routing a 100% speedrun of the game last Thursday, which I discovered randomly as I was browsing Twitch. After multiple runs, he's brought his clear time of the game from 36 minutes and 27 seconds down to an impressive [b]17 minutes and 13 seconds[/b]! 

His run showcases many cool ticks and techniques that you can perform in the game. If you want to see them or are even interested in speedrunning Whirlwind Magician yourself, I highly recommend watching the run! He was also generous enough to provide English commentary for it.

[b]SPOILER WARNING[/b]: As a 100% run, this speedrun reveals how to obtain every secret item and also reveals the [u]secret ending[/u] you receive for getting all of said items. Don't watch it if you don't want to be spoiled!
[previewyoutube=J8kSDGuXeYo;full][/previewyoutube]
Sekeri is a fan of indie games and looks for obscure games to speedrun each week on his Twitch channel, so go subscribe to him if you're interested in that!
https://www.twitch.tv/sekeri_rat
[img]https://static-cdn.jtvnw.net/jtv_user_pictures/ddb58cc8-a377-4f15-a6f7-509a8e035afe-profile_image-70x70.png[/img]

Whirlwind Magician was intentionally designed to have many hidden tricks, techniques, and skips you can perform to save time, inspired by games like Super Metroid. So it makes me very happy to see people like Sekeri discovering them and utilizing them in speedruns. While this early run is impressive, I will say that there are still many tricks and skips yet to be discovered!

I messaged Sekeri and it sounds like he'll be submitting this run to the Fluff Event, a video game streaming marathon on Twitch that raises funds for charity. It'll be taking place from May 30th to June 1st. https://fluffevent.fr/en/#association 

I'm curious to see how this event will go down, and I wonder if we'll start to see more Whirlwind Magician speedruns!

notes.title: Thank you for 11+ positive reviews!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I wanted to thank all of you who purchased the game so far and especially those of you who left a review! It really means a lot to me! We have reached the 10 total reviews needed to generate a review score on the Steam page, which means the game should hopefully be seeing more traffic!

And so far it seems like everyone has been having a great time with the game! I'm very glad about that.

Of course, though we have reached the 10 Steam review threshold, additional reviews are still helpful and appreciated! I would love to hear your thoughts on the game as well as your critiques if you have any - that can help me improve the game in updates. It also helps attract more players and helps prospective buyers with deciding if the game is right for them.

Once again, thank you all for supporting Whirlwind Magician!

notes.title: Whirlwind Magician is available now!
notes.content:
It's finally here!

If you like the game, please consider leaving a review on Steam! Steam games unlock a lot more visibility when they reach at least 10 total reviews - so leaving a review is one of the best ways to support the game. It can be as short as 1 word even, and more reviews after the game reaches 10 will still be helpful.

If you encounter any bugs or technical issues, you can report them in the discussions thread I posted or send an email to samuraimantis.help@gmail.com.

notes.title: Whirlwind Magician is Releasing May 7th!
notes.content:
Whirlwind Magician finally has a release date! It will be available on May 7th at 10AM PDT (That's exactly 2 weeks from now!) It will cost just $2.99 USD. The price may be lower or higher in countries outside the United States.

I'm very excited for when all of you will finally get to play the game. I hope you're looking forward to it!

[list]

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello! I've released a small update to the [i]Whirlwind Magician[/i] Demo: Save files will now track the amount of time you've spent playing, like how save files in most platformers do.
Some notes about the playtime stat:
[list]
[*]Playtime will not accumulate during cutscenes or while loading a level.
[*]Playtime WILL accumulate while looking at the map and while browsing the pause menu in-game. I thought it would be a good idea to do this since speedrunners tend to prefer including time spent browsing menus into their total time. In the full version of the game, time-attack mode—which is meant for speedrunning—will automatically skip cutscenes.
[*]Older save files from before this update will still work, but will start at 0 for their playtime.
[/list]

If you have any questions or feedback on how the playtime stat works, you can leave a comment below or email me at samuraimantis.help@gmail.com
